items.exampleZh: 我很愛吃水果，尤其是蘋果。

items.exampleEn: I will certainly come to your party.
items.exampleZh: 我一定會去參加你的派對。

items.exampleEn: Once upon a time, a king lived in a castle.
items.exampleZh: 從前從前，有一位國王住在城堡裡。（once upon a time＝從前）

items.exampleEn: There is a small village beyond the mountains.
items.exampleZh: 山的另一邊有一個小村莊。

items.audioEn: The movie was quite long, but I really enjoyed it.
items.audioZh: 這部電影相當長，不過我真的很喜歡。
items.questionZh: 說話的人覺得那部電影怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: I can certainly help you with that.
items.sentenceZh: 這件事我一定可以幫你。

items.sentenceEn: The room itself is small, but it's nice.
items.sentenceZh: 房間本身不大，但是很不錯。

items.stemEn: She is the best player on our team, so she will ____ win.
items.stemZh: 她是我們隊上最強的選手，所以她一定會贏。
這個生日蛋糕是我自己做的。

items.passageEn: Once upon a time, a little bird lived in a tall tree. One day, she wanted to see what was beyond the mountains. Her friends said, "It is quite far. You will certainly get tired." But the bird simply said, "I want to see it myself." She flew for three days. Beyond the mountains, she found a beautiful lake. She was tired, but very happy.
items.passageZh: 從前從前，有一隻小鳥住在一棵高高的樹上。有一天，牠想看看山的另一邊有什麼。牠的朋友說：「那裡相當遠，你一定會累。」可是小鳥只說：「我想親眼看看。」牠飛了三天。在山的另一邊，牠發現了一座美麗的湖。牠很累，但是非常開心。

options: 想去山下那條小河裡學游泳
想到別的樹上找新的朋友玩
想看看山的另一邊有什麼

questions.questionZh: 朋友們對小鳥說了什麼？

items.promptZh: 這家餐廳的菜相當不錯，尤其是湯。
referenceEn: The food at this restaurant is quite good, especially the soup.
This restaurant has quite good food, especially the soup.
rubricZh: especially 放在要強調的部分前面（例如 especially the soup）
「相當不錯」可寫例如 quite good、really good、pretty good
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 The food is）

items.instructionZh: 用 myself 造一個句子，說說一件你自己完成的事。
referenceEn: I cleaned my whole room myself.
I made dinner by myself yesterday.
rubricZh: myself 指「我自己」，句子的主詞是 I
myself 可放在句尾（I did it myself），也可用 by myself
說已經完成的事用過去式或現在完成式（例如 cleaned、have made）
